content.short: Veridise is a blockchain security company founded by world-class researchers, delivering security research and software analysis tools for Web3 developers.
content.description: Veridise is a blockchain security company founded by a team of world-class researchers. The firm is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge security research and advanced software analysis tools to Web3 developers, helping them build safer, more reliable protocols and applications. Veridise has earned a reputation as a proven leader in auditing zero-knowledge circuits, smart contracts, and diverse blockchain implementations, guiding projects through rigorous security validation and risk assessment.

resources.title: How a Negated Check Cost SuperRare $730K
resources.tldr: An access control bug that is easy to miss precisely because a check is present — it just fails to restrict anything. From Veridise's auditor series.
